svg.title: Birthday weekend: Zambales, November 7-8, 2026
svg.desc: San Antonio overnight stay. Personal base allowance 1500 pesos plus extra cash; 550 shared contribution, 300 shared Saturday ulam fund and 650 own Sunday meals. Saturday Limliwa Beach, birthday dinner and games at the house. Sunday sinangag, eggs and longganisa breakfast, main ATV activity or SandBox alternative, then Barn by Conti’s lunch and Clark Parade Grounds for optional museum, walking and bike rental. Leave Clark at 7 PM; target home 10 PM, subject to traffic, dinner and drop-offs. Confirm attendance by November 2, 2026.
